UI unit with no rules.md of its own: the editable locale and base currency and their server-reported source are specified in functional-spec.md §3.2; the no-overwrite-on-refresh rule is u1/user-registry and u4/preferences-consent's

UI unit with no rules.md of its own: pending_deletion routing to the recovery surface, the exact recoveryEndsAt date, and Restore are specified in functional-spec.md §2.1, §3.6 and §4 (W3, W4); the 30-day window and the restore use case are u5-account-lifecycle's
UI unit with no rules.md of its own: the 410 terminal state and the deleted-status screen are specified in functional-spec.md §3.6 and §3.7; the day-31 erasure itself is u5-account-lifecycle's

UI unit with no rules.md of its own: the preferences panel that saves locale and base currency and sends no stored financial value is specified in functional-spec.md §3.2; the values-unchanged rule is u4-preferences-consent's
